cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You had empty seats? My opening had two people and both left. We'll discuss mine first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. Would you like my complimentary drink?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your offer is accepted. My theatre couldn't even afford to console us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: May I talk now? My dad left before my scene.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After this: mine asked for a refund. You may order another drink, but bring it here. I haven't finished being listened to.

reason: Let B explicitly seek a speaking turn and A withhold it after making the larger hurt claim.
